policies.text: Commercial refrigeration units receive priority tariff exemption if they utilize natural A1 refrigerants and maintain a storage capacity of at least 500 liters.
An industrial lubricant achieves high-load certification when its kinematic viscosity exceeds 100 centistokes at 40 degrees Celsius.

Listing on the national green equipment catalog is granted to a solar conversion unit that holds an Energy Star certification, maintains an ISO 14001 environmental badge, or achieves a minimum energy conversion efficiency of 95%.
Municipal clean tech incentive clearance is issued for a registered eco-friendly unit that additionally offers a product warranty duration of 5 years or more.
Compliance with local structure thermal standards requires an insulating material to achieve a minimum thermal resistance rating of 4 R-value.
